description: This file defines a MetricConverter in the Kubernetes custom metrics client, handling version conversions and serialization for custom metrics API objects.

classes.name: MetricConverter
classes.description: A class that handles conversion between different versions of custom metrics objects.

methods.name: NewMetricConverter
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MetricConverter with appropriate scheme, codecs, and versioner.

methods.name: Scheme
methods.description: Returns the scheme used by the MetricConverter.

methods.name: Codecs
methods.description: Returns the codecs used by the MetricConverter.

methods.name: ConvertListOptionsToVersion
methods.description: Converts MetricListOptions to a specified GroupVersion.

methods.name: ConvertResultToVersion
methods.description: Converts a rest.Result object to a specified GroupVersion.

methods.name: UnsafeConvertToVersionVia
methods.description: Converts a runtime.Object to a specified external version via internal versioning, ensuring backward compatibility.
